title: Granete SketchUp Publish Manifest v1
description: Canonical versioned schema of the semantic manifest artifact that accompanies every SketchUp design revision publication (#392 / DT-8, ADR-0003). The manifest is an ARTIFACT COMPANION: the relational DesignRevisionItem snapshot — always derived server-side from the DesignWorkingCopy — remains the authoritative indexed truth. Published revisions keep their manifest bytes forever; a future v2 must never rewrite v1 payloads. The Go validator (internal/domain/design_publish.go ParseDesignPublishManifest) and this schema must stay in parity (fixture tests pin it).

projectId.description: Must equal the project that owns the design; server-validated.

designId.description: Must equal the design being published; server-validated.

baseRevisionId.description: The exact revision the authoring client worked from. Null only for a first (R1) publication. Must equal the authoritative design_working_copies.base_revision_id at prepare AND at finalize (fail-closed optimistic concurrency).

items.description: EXCLUSIVELY Granete-managed FurnitureInstances. Unmanaged architecture/decoration geometry (walls, plants, aux tables, lights) never enters the manifest — it can never become BOM/machining input (DT-8 negative proof B). The item set must exactly equal the design working copy item set at prepare and at finalize.

client.description: v1 manifests exist exactly for the SketchUp authoring client; a new client requires a new manifest version, never a silent widening.

furnitureInstanceId.description: Backend-owned business identity (I2). Never derived from name, GUID, persistent_id or geometry (I7). Duplicate IDs within one manifest are rejected.

technicalClientLocator.description: Optional technical locator (e.g. SketchUp persistent_id). NEVER business identity (ADR-0003 §4, I7).
